sections.text: An anatomically detailed arterial-venous network model. Cerebral and coronary circulation

sections.label: Figure 1 caption
sections.text: Vascular anatomy of the ADAVN model. (A) arterial vascular anatomy with over 2,185 vessels. (B) venous vascular anatomy with 189 vessels. Insets show details of the circulation circuits in the head and in the heart. Veins colored in cyan contain a venous valve at its proximal extremity.
